title: Under the hood: one app for Android and iPhone
thisBuild: Nothing should look or work differently. The screens and the app's logic moved into shared code that the iPhone version will use too.
Every screen was checked against the build before the move: 482 test screenshots, the same pixel for pixel.
Numbers with decimals always use a dot now (a phone set to German used to show a comma).
watch: Play a mess for a few minutes and use every tab: anything that looks or sounds off, send a note.
Import a sound, sample the mic and open a mess file: those now go through new code paths.
limits: The iPhone app is not on TestFlight yet: that needs your Apple Developer account.
